items.item_text: resume
cover letter
Valid California Driver’s License.
High school diploma or equivalent.

The Storeroom Clerk reports to the MCB Storekeeper Supervisor, who is responsible for the oversight and management of the stockroom functions in the Department of Molecular Biology at two locations (e.g., Weill Hall, and Barker Hall). The primary responsibilities of this position are purchasing, data entry, special orders, receiving and restocking, customer service, mail delivery, inventory, and keeping the stockroom clean and orderly. This position also provides backup with the departmental receiving and delivery as needed.
Run POSIM reports daily to determine stocking needs, build purchase orders in POSIM and in BFS, and/or the ability to learn, call in orders, verify pricing, follow up on order status.
Prepares purchase orders by researching and recommending vendors/prices/equipment and may identify substitutes.
Special order items for customers that are not carried by the storeroom.
This includes finding the correct vendor and item, researching optimal pricing, numerous customer and vendor contact calls, and follow-up.
Inventory Maintenance - 20%
Receive orders in POSIM and/or the ability to learn, barcode and shelve items.
Conduct weekly cycle counts of merchandise, research discrepancies.
Approve invoices for payment in BFS and/or the ability to learn, investigate and reconcile discrepancies with vendors and/or customers.
Track bluCard transactions for validity, send approval and backups to Recharge Analyst on a weekly basis.
Run POSIM reports and/or the ability to learn to research inventory inconsistencies, determine shrinkage, and adjust database accordingly.
Input customer sales into POSIM and/or the ability to learn hourly.
Assist customers with questions and problems pertaining to storeroom merchandise (pricing, types of items, safe handling information), orders, shipments, and billing.
Prepares response to routine correspondence.
Receiving and Delivery - 5%
Serve as backup for Storekeeper/Receiving person when necessary.
This includes signing for shipments, checking items into BearBuy, delivering to labs, and maintaining delivery logs.
General Housekeeping - 5%
Keep the storeroom and surrounding areas tidy and organized.
Defrost freezers three times per year or as needed.
Computer proficiency in Word and Excel.
Requires verbal and written communication skills, active listening, critical thinking, multi-task and time management skills.
Accuracy in data entry and ability to keep detailed, accurate records and maintain filing systems.
Excellent customer service skills in high demand situations.
Ability to interface and work with students, staff, faculty, drivers and vendors.
Ability to manually lift and move items up to 75 lbs.
